summary: The capacity, KKT-slack, flux, and residual-rank arguments otherwise follow from the supplied predecessor facts, but the proof contains a false pointwise positivity assertion in the amplified-measure step.
critical_errors: After assuming only \(\mathfrak A=\sum_f A_f>0\), the proof claims that Equation (16) gives \(0<A_f\le q_f\le r_f\) for every \(f\). This is false: positive total mass guarantees only that at least one \(A_f\) is positive, while other coefficients may be zero.
repair_hints: Replace the false pointwise claim by \(0\le A_f\le q_f\le r_f\) for every \(f\), together with the separate observation that \(\mathfrak A>0\) makes at least one coefficient positive. Those two facts are exactly what is needed to make \(\sigma_{\mathrm{amp}}\) a nonzero positive submeasure.
